import ImbalancedChen.Part3CommonPFiniteReduction

noncomputable section

open Classical Finset
open scoped BigOperators
open MathlibNt.AnalyticNumberTheory.LargeSieve.LiLiuPrereqFouvry

namespace CommonPM2FiniteFold

def shiftDifference (d : MediumAtom) (v : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((v : ℤ) - d.residue).natAbs

def tau (v : ℕ) : ℝ := (v.divisors.card : ℝ)

def fourthDivisorWeight (d : MediumAtom) (v : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (fouvryTau 4 (shiftDifference d v) : ℝ) ^ 4

def productCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Ioc 0 (Nat.floor (6 * d.scale))).filter (fun v => (v : ℤ) ≠ d.residue)

/-- The literal actual row, including its signed divisor-deletion gate. -/
def rowSum (d : MediumAtom) (p m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression p m,
    ‖d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n‖ *
      (fouvryTau 4 (shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ) ^ 2

def moment (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
    ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m * rowSum d p m ^ 2

/-- Every label is (p,m,n), not an unlabelled modulus or a pair quotient. -/
def activeLabels (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) :=
  ((d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier) ×ˢ
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier).filter
    (fun z => d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight z.1.2 ≠ 0 ∧
      z.2 ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression z.1.1 z.1.2)

def labelProduct (z : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) : ℕ := z.1.2 * z.2

def foldedSum (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  ∑ v ∈ productCarrier d,
    tau v * tau (shiftDifference d v) * fourthDivisorWeight d v

/-- Original outside energies occur exactly once. -/
def outsideEnergy (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  (∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ^ 2) *
    (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2)

def MediumAdmissible (B : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ d.U ∧ 1 ≤ d.V ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q1 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q2 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q3 ∧
  Real.exp (Real.exp 1) < d.scale ∧
  c0 * d.scale ≤ (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + κ) ∧
  d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-σ) ∧
  d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * σ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ^ (7 / 32 : ℝ) * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 ^ 5 * d.Q3 ^ 2 <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  d.U ^ (1 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q1 *
      d.Q2 ^ (5 - 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q3 ^ (2 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ‖d.alpha n‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n ≠ 0 → ∀ p : ℕ,
    Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n →
      d.scale ^ (1 / (Real.log (Real.log d.scale)) ^ 3) < (p : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ≤ (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ B) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ‖d.gamma1 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma1 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ‖d.gamma2 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma2 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ‖d.gamma3 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma3 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs))

@[simp] lemma pow_succ_nonneg [PosMulMono M₀] (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a ^ (n + 1)
  | 0 => (pow_one a).symm ▸ ha
  | _ + 1 => pow_succ a _ ▸ mul_nonneg (pow_succ_nonneg ha _) ha

@[simp] lemma pow_nonneg [ZeroLEOneClass M₀] [PosMulMono M₀] (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a ^ n
  | 0 => pow_zero a ▸ zero_le_one
  | n + 1 => pow_succ a n ▸ mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg ha _) ha

@[gcongr]
theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left [PosMulMono α] (hbc : b ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : a * b ≤ a * c :=
  PosMulMono.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha hbc

@[gcongr]
theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right [MulPosMono α] (hbc : b ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : b * a ≤ c * a :=
  MulPosMono.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha hbc

theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonneg [PosMulMono α] [MulPosMono α]
    (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : c ≤ d) (a0 : 0 ≤ a) (d0 : 0 ≤ d) : a * c ≤ b * d :=
  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₂ a0).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h₁ d0)

theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonneg' [PosMulMono α] [MulPosMono α]
    (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : c ≤ d) (c0 : 0 ≤ c) (b0 : 0 ≤ b) : a * c ≤ b * d :=
  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h₁ c0).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₂ b0)

lemma sq_nonneg [ExistsAddOfLE R] [PosMulMono R] [AddLeftMono R]
    (a : R) : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 := by
  obtain ha | ha := le_or_gt 0 a
  · exact pow_succ_nonneg ha _

/-- Note that most of the lemmas about powers of two refer to it as `sq`. -/
@[to_additive two_nsmul] lemma pow_two (a : M) : a ^ 2 = a * a := by rw [pow_succ, pow_one]
